props.name: accept
props.description:
Comma-separated list of accepted file types. Each entry is a case-insensitive extension
(`.png`), a MIME wildcard (`image/*`), or an exact MIME type (`application/pdf`); `*`
accepts everything. It is also passed to the native file input and enforced on dropped
and picked files, which fail with `typeMismatch` in `onValueInvalid`.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection for uncontrolled usage. Defaults to `null` in single mode and `[]` when `multiple`.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text inside the upload area, such as the accepted types. It is linked to the control through `aria-describedby`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: dropzone
props.description:
Whether files can be dragged and dropped onto the control. When `false`, drag events are
ignored, but clicking the control or pressing `Enter` / `Space` still opens the file dialog.

props.name: fileIcon
props.description: Icon shown in a file entry when there is no image thumbnail, such as for non-image files.

props.name: fileList
props.description:
Whether to render the list of selected files below the control, with an object-URL
thumbnail for image files. When `false`, no list or previews are rendered and `itemRender`
is not used.

props.name: form
props.description: The `id` of a `<form>` the hidden file input belongs to, for a control rendered outside that form.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown in the upload area.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the hidden native `<input type="file">` that backs the control.

props.name: itemRender
props.description:
Replaces the default entry for each selected file in the file list. Receives the `file`,
its `index`, an image `previewUrl` when available, a `remove()` function, and `disabled`
(`true` while disabled or read-only). Render a list item (`<li>`), since entries sit in a `<ul>`.
examples:
import { FileUpload } from 'moraine' (
  • {item.file.name}
    • )} />

props.name: label
props.description: Label text inside the upload area. It also names the control for assistive technology unless a surrounding `Field` supplies a label.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description:
Maximum total number of selected files, counting files already selected. Files beyond the
limit are dropped and reported as `tooLong` in `onValueInvalid`. Only accepted when
`multiple` is `true`; single mode always keeps one file. Unlimited by default.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum accepted file size in bytes, inclusive. Larger files are rejected with `rangeOverflow`.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum accepted file size in bytes, inclusive. Smaller files are rejected with `rangeUnderflow`.

props.name: multiple
props.description:
Whether several files can be selected. When `true`, new files are appended to the current
selection and `value` is a `File[]`; otherwise a new file replaces the current one.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called when files are added or removed. Receives the complete new selection, a `File[]`
when `multiple` and `File | null` otherwise (`null` once the file is removed). It is not
called for files rejected by validation or while the control is disabled or read-only.

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description:
Called after a pick or drop with the files that failed validation, each with its `reasons`:
`typeMismatch` (not in `accept`), `rangeUnderflow` (under `minSize`), `rangeOverflow` (over
`maxSize`), `duplicate` (same name, size, type, and modification time as a selected file),
or `tooLong` (over `maxFiles`). Accepted
files from the same batch are still added and reported through `onValueChange`. It cannot
cancel the pick and is unrelated to the native `invalid` event.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Localized message overrides for this file upload instance. `label` is the accessible name
used when no visible `label` is set, and `remove` builds each remove button's `aria-label`
from the file `name`.
examples:
import { FileUpload } from 'moraine'

<FileUpload
  label="Avatar"
  translations={{ label: 'Upload avatar', remove: ({ name }) => `Delete ${name}` }}
/>

props.name: value
props.description:
The selected file(s) (controlled): `File | null` in single mode, `File[]` when `multiple`.
`undefined` leaves the selection uncontrolled; pass `null` (single) or `[]` (multiple) for a
controlled empty selection. Update it from `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the control: a large dashed drop area, or a compact picker button.
